section.title: Django vs Spring Boot
section.subtitle: Framework basics, structure, URLs/views, models, ORM, migrations, admin, forms, auth, middleware, REST APIs, JWT, permissions, pagination and testing.

python.definition: Django is a high-level Python web framework with 'batteries included' — ORM, admin, auth, templating built in. MTV pattern (Model-Template-View).
python.code:
pip install django
django-admin startproject mysite
cd mysite
python manage.py startapp polls
python manage.py runserver
# http://127.0.0.1:8000

java.definition: Spring Boot is a Java framework on the Spring ecosystem — auto-configuration, embedded server, dependency injection. MVC pattern.

python.definition: Project = settings/urls/wsgi. Apps = reusable modules with models.py, views.py, urls.py, admin.py, migrations/.
python.code:
mysite/
  manage.py
  mysite/         # project config
    settings.py
    urls.py
  polls/          # app
    models.py
    views.py
    urls.py
    admin.py
    migrations/

java.definition: Maven/Gradle project: src/main/java (packages by feature/layer), src/main/resources (application.properties), src/test/java.
java.code:
myapp/
  pom.xml
  src/main/java/com/example/
    MyApp.java
    controller/   # REST endpoints
    service/      # business logic
    repository/   # DB access
    model/        # entities
  src/main/resources/
    application.properties

topics.title: URLs & Views
topics.learn: Request handling — mapping URLs to code.

python.definition: urls.py maps URL patterns to view functions; views receive HttpRequest and return HttpResponse (or render templates / JsonResponse).

java.definition: @RestController + @GetMapping/@PostMapping handle requests; methods return objects serialised to JSON automatically.

python.definition: models.Model subclasses map to tables; each field (CharField, IntegerField...) maps to a column. Django generates the SQL.
python.code:
from django.db import models

class Student(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    age = models.IntegerField()
    email = models.EmailField(unique=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

java.definition: JPA @Entity classes map to tables; @Id marks the primary key; fields map to columns.

topics.title: ORM — Database Operations
topics.learn: Querying the database through objects instead of raw SQL.

python.definition: Django ORM: Model.objects.all()/.get()/.filter()/.create() — returns QuerySets, lazy-evaluated.
python.code:
# Query
Student.objects.all()
Student.objects.get(id=1)
Student.objects.filter(age__gte=18).order_by("name")

# Create / update / delete
Student.objects.create(name="Priya", age=20)
s.name = "P"; s.save()
s.delete()

java.definition: Spring Data JPA repositories — extend JpaRepository to get CRUD methods free; or use EntityManager/JPQL.

python.definition: makemigrations detects model changes and writes migration files; migrate applies them to the DB.
python.code:
python manage.py makemigrations   # detect changes
python manage.py migrate          # apply to DB
python manage.py sqlmigrate polls 0001  # view SQL

java.definition: Flyway or Liquibase manage schema versions via SQL migration files; Hibernate ddl-auto can also update schema.
java.code:
# application.properties
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update

# Or Flyway:
# src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql
# CREATE TABLE students (...);
# then: flyway migrate (auto on startup)

python.definition: Django Admin is an auto-generated CRUD UI — register models in admin.py, get a full admin panel at /admin.
python.code:
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Student

admin.site.register(Student)
# -> http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin

java.definition: No built-in admin — use Spring Boot Admin (monitoring) or build custom pages with Thymeleaf/React.

python.definition: ModelForm auto-validates from model fields; is_valid()/cleaned_data handle checks. errors dict shows failures.

java.definition: Bean Validation annotations (@NotNull, @Min, @Email) on fields + @Valid on controller params; errors via BindingResult.

python.definition: django.contrib.auth provides User model, login()/logout() views, @login_required decorator.

java.definition: Spring Security handles auth — configure SecurityFilterChain, use UserDetailsService, password encoder (BCrypt).

topics.title: Middleware & Permissions
topics.learn: Request processing pipeline and access control.

python.definition: Middleware processes every request/response (auth, sessions, CSRF). @login_required / permission_required decorators gate views.

java.definition: Servlet Filters and Spring interceptors (HandlerInterceptor) sit in the request pipeline; @PreAuthorize does method-level security.

topics.title: REST API — Introduction
topics.learn: What REST is — resources, HTTP verbs, statelessness.

python.definition: REST maps resources to URLs and operations to HTTP verbs (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE). Django REST Framework (DRF) builds APIs on this.
python.code:
pip install djangorestframework

# REST endpoints
GET    /api/students/     -> list
POST   /api/students/     -> create
GET    /api/students/1/   -> retrieve
PUT    /api/students/1/   -> update
DELETE /api/students/1/   -> delete

java.definition: Spring MVC @RestController exposes REST endpoints; Spring Data REST can auto-generate them from repositories.

topics.title: Serializers / DTOs
topics.learn: Converting between Python/Java objects and JSON.

python.definition: DRF serializers convert model instances <-> JSON, and validate incoming data.

java.definition: DTOs (Data Transfer Objects) with Jackson annotations (@JsonProperty) shape the JSON; records work well in modern Java.

python.definition: FBV: plain functions taking request -> response. CBV: classes inheriting View/ListView/DetailView with get()/post() methods.

java.definition: Spring is class-based by nature — @RestController classes with annotated handler methods. No function-style endpoints.

topics.title: Generic Views
topics.learn: Pre-built views for common patterns (list, detail, create, update, delete).

python.definition: django.views.generic provides ListView, DetailView, CreateView, UpdateView, DeleteView — only model + template needed.

java.definition: No direct generic-view equivalent — Spring Data REST auto-exposes full CRUD from a repository interface.

topics.title: ViewSets & Routers
topics.learn: Automatic CRUD endpoints for a whole model.

python.definition: DRF ModelViewSet + DefaultRouter auto-generate all CRUD routes from a queryset — minimal code for a full API.
python.code:
from rest_framework import viewsets
from rest_framework.routers import DefaultRouter

class StudentViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Student.objects.all()
    serializer_class = StudentSerializer

router = DefaultRouter()
router.register(r"students", StudentViewSet)
# -> /api/students/ GET POST, /api/students/1/ GET PUT DELETE

java.definition: Spring equivalent = Spring Data REST repository above, or a base controller class with common CRUD methods.

python.definition: DRF APIView or generic views implement each HTTP method explicitly for full control.

java.definition: Standard @RestController with five methods — one per HTTP verb.

python.definition: djangorestframework-simplejwt issues JWT access/refresh tokens; client sends 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

java.definition: jjwt or spring-security-oauth2-resource-server validates JWTs; configure a JwtDecoder and SecurityFilterChain.

topics.title: Permissions & Authorization
topics.learn: Who can do what — role/permission checks.

python.definition: DRF permission_classes: IsAuthenticated, IsAdminUser, or custom has_permission(). Django groups/permissions also work.

java.definition: @PreAuthorize / hasRole() / hasAuthority() annotations + method security (@EnableMethodSecurity).

python.definition: DRF PageNumberPagination splits results into pages; django-filter adds query-param filtering (e.g. ?age=20&search=name).

java.definition: Spring Pageable parameter auto-paginates; JpaSpecificationExecutor or QueryDSL builds dynamic filters.

python.definition: Serializer validation: field types, validators=, custom validate_<field>() methods — invalid data returns 400 with error details.

java.definition: @Valid + Bean Validation annotations on DTO fields; @ExceptionHandler formats errors consistently.

topics.title: API Testing with Postman
topics.learn: Testing APIs manually and with collections.

python.definition: Postman is language-agnostic — test DRF endpoints with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE requests, JSON bodies, and auth headers.
python.code:
# Example requests against a Django API
GET    http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/students/
POST   http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/students/
       Body (JSON): {"name": "Priya", "age": 20, "email": "p@x.com"}
PUT    http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/students/1/
DELETE http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/students/1/
# Auth header: Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>

java.definition: Same Postman workflow against Spring Boot endpoints (default port 8080). Use Tests tab + environments for variables.
java.code:
GET    http://localhost:8080/api/students
POST   http://localhost:8080/api/students
       Body (JSON): {"name": "Priya", "age": 20, "email": "p@x.com"}
PUT    http://localhost:8080/api/students/1
DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/students/1
# Auth header: Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>
